Per-channel agreement between the **fixed-mode** exponent fit over 1–80 Hz and
over 1–45 Hz, per modality, from the cached `aperiodic` tables of the two runs
(no refit). We report Pearson and Spearman correlation, a Bland–Altman plot
(mean vs difference — the range effect is largely a systematic shift a scatter
hides), and the per-region mean shift $\Delta\chi = \chi_{1\text{–}80} -
\chi_{1\text{–}45}$ to test whether it is uniform or region-dependent.

```{python}
#| label: imports
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
from plotnine import (
    aes,
    element_text,
    facet_wrap,
    geom_abline,
    geom_hline,
    geom_point,
    geom_text,
    geom_tile,
    ggplot,
    labs,
    scale_fill_gradient2,
    theme,
    theme_bw,
)

from pesco import config, store

PROJECT_DIR = Path("/Users/daniel/PhD/spectral-comparison/code/")
DB_PATH = PROJECT_DIR / "data/interim/analysis.duckdb"
fig_dir = Path("figures/chapter2")
fig_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
LOBE_ORDER = ["Occipital", "Parietal", "Frontal", "Temporal", "Insula"]

H_FULL = store.params_hash(
    config.SPECPARAM_SETTINGS, config.FREQ_RANGE, config.SELECTED_MODE
)
```

```{python}
#| label: load
con = store.open_db(DB_PATH)
H_45 = store.find_run(con, label="range_1-45")
full = store.load(con, "aperiodic", H_FULL).query("mode == 'fixed'")
narrow = store.load(con, "aperiodic", H_45).query("mode == 'fixed'")
channels = store.load(con, "channels", H_FULL)[["channel", "dataset", "region", "Lobe"]]
con.close()

paired = (
    full[["channel", "dataset", "exponent"]]
    .rename(columns={"exponent": "chi_1_80"})
    .merge(
        narrow[["channel", "dataset", "exponent"]].rename(
            columns={"exponent": "chi_1_45"}
        ),
        on=["channel", "dataset"],
    )
    .merge(channels, on=["channel", "dataset"], how="left")
)
paired["delta"] = paired["chi_1_80"] - paired["chi_1_45"]
paired["mean_chi"] = (paired["chi_1_80"] + paired["chi_1_45"]) / 2
paired["dataset"] = pd.Categorical(paired["dataset"], config.DATASETS, ordered=True)
```

```{python}
#| label: correlations
#| output: true
rows = []
for ds, g in paired.groupby("dataset", observed=True):
    r, _ = stats.pearsonr(g["chi_1_45"], g["chi_1_80"])
    rho, _ = stats.spearmanr(g["chi_1_45"], g["chi_1_80"])
    rows.append(
        {
            "dataset": ds,
            "n_channels": len(g),
            "median_1_80": round(g["chi_1_80"].median(), 3),
            "median_1_45": round(g["chi_1_45"].median(), 3),
            "mean_delta": round(g["delta"].mean(), 3),
            "pearson_r": round(r, 3),
            "spearman_rho": round(rho, 3),
        }
    )
range_corr = pd.DataFrame(rows)
range_corr
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-scatter-ba
#| output: true
ann = range_corr.assign(
    label=lambda d: "r=" + d["pearson_r"].map("{:.2f}".format)
    + "  ρ=" + d["spearman_rho"].map("{:.2f}".format),
    x=paired.groupby("dataset", observed=True)["chi_1_45"].min().values,
    y=paired.groupby("dataset", observed=True)["chi_1_80"].max().values,
)
scatter = (
    ggplot(paired, aes("chi_1_45", "chi_1_80"))
    + geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="#999999")
    + geom_point(size=1.2, alpha=0.4, stroke=0, color="#2C7FB8")
    + geom_text(ann, aes("x", "y", label="label"), ha="left", va="top", size=9)
    + facet_wrap("dataset", scales="free")
    + labs(
        x="exponent χ (1–45 Hz)", y="exponent χ (1–80 Hz)",
        title="Fitting-range agreement of the fixed exponent",
    )
    + theme_bw()
    + theme(figure_size=(9, 4.2), plot_title=element_text(size=11))
)
ba = (
    ggplot(paired, aes("mean_chi", "delta"))
    + geom_hline(yintercept=0, color="#999999", linetype="dashed")
    + geom_point(size=1.2, alpha=0.4, stroke=0, color="#E8546B")
    + facet_wrap("dataset", scales="free")
    + labs(
        x="mean exponent  (χ₁₋₈₀ + χ₁₋₄₅)/2",
        y="Δχ = χ₁₋₈₀ − χ₁₋₄₅",
        title="Bland–Altman: range effect is a systematic shift",
    )
    + theme_bw()
    + theme(figure_size=(9, 4.2), plot_title=element_text(size=11))
)
for name, f, h in [("h3_fitting_range_scatter", scatter, 4.2),
                   ("h3_fitting_range_bland_altman", ba, 4.2)]:
    for ext in ("svg", "pdf", "png"):
        f.save(fig_dir / f"{name}.{ext}", width=9, height=h, dpi=150, verbose=False)
scatter
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-ba
#| output: true
ba
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-region-delta
#| output: true
region_delta = (
    paired.groupby(["dataset", "Lobe", "region"], observed=True)["delta"]
    .mean()
    .reset_index()
)
order = (
    channels.assign(
        lobe_rank=lambda d: d["Lobe"].map(
            {lo: i for i, lo in enumerate(LOBE_ORDER)}
        )
    )
    .drop_duplicates("region")
    .sort_values(["lobe_rank", "region"])["region"]
    .tolist()
)
region_delta["region"] = pd.Categorical(region_delta["region"], order, ordered=True)
region_delta["dataset"] = pd.Categorical(
    region_delta["dataset"], config.DATASETS, ordered=True
)
lim = float(np.nanmax(np.abs(region_delta["delta"])))
region_fig = (
    ggplot(region_delta, aes("dataset", "region", fill="delta"))
    + geom_tile(color="white", size=0.3)
    + scale_fill_gradient2(
        low="#2166AC", mid="white", high="#B2182B",
        midpoint=0, limits=(-lim, lim), name="mean Δχ",
    )
    + labs(x="", y="", title="Per-region mean range shift Δχ (1–80 − 1–45)")
    + theme_bw()
    + theme(
        figure_size=(5, 9),
        axis_text_y=element_text(size=6),
        plot_title=element_text(size=11),
    )
)
for ext in ("svg", "pdf", "png"):
    region_fig.save(
        fig_dir / f"h3_fitting_range_region_delta.{ext}",
        width=5, height=9, dpi=150, verbose=False,
    )
region_fig
```
